description: This file contains integration test cases for verifying the behavior of Loan Product external ID handling within the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup, and test methods for creating, retrieving, updating with valid external IDs, as well as handling invalid external IDs.

classes.name: LoanProductExternalIdTest
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying Loan Product external ID related functionalities in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured setup, request/response specifications, and helper classes before each test.

methods.name: testLoanProductWithExternalId
methods.description: Tests creating, retrieving, and updating a loan product using a valid external ID.

methods.name: testLoanProductWithInvalidExternalId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a loan product with an invalid external ID, expecting an error.
